shared_elements: low-relief carving on a rock surface
justification: A clearly depicts rows of animals — quadrupeds and elongated serpentine forms arranged in stacked horizontal registers in shallow relief — while B shows only faint, weathered rounded and curvilinear bosses on a rock face with no identifiable creature, figure or motif. The only correspondence is the generic fact of shallow relief working with rounded shapes, which is not specific enough to suggest a shared iconographic scheme; the biggest difference is that A has a legible register composition of recognisable animals and B has no discernible subject at all.
